    scope = character # Player Character

        save_scope_as = player

                    limit = {

DI_tm_destroy_building_castle_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {

                else_if = { limit = { has_building = castle_03 } remove_building = castle_03 }

            }
        }
    }

            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = legendary_palace }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = legendary_palace
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = legendary_palace
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_03
                }
            }
        }
    }

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_03 } remove_building = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_02 } remove_building = holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_02 }

            scope:province = {
                if = {

                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = rainbow_mountains_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = rainbow_mountains_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = rainbow_mountains_01
                }
            }
        }
    }

                        add_special_building_slot = meteora_01
                    }

                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = white_deer_grotto_academy_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = white_deer_grotto_academy_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = white_deer_grotto_academy_01
                }
            }
        }
    }

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = hanxing_mines_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hanxing_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hanxing_mines_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hanxing_mines_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hanxing_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hanxing_mines_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hanxing_mines_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hanxing_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hanxing_mines_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hanxing_mines_04 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hanxing_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hanxing_mines_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_hanxing_mines_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = hanxing_mines_04 } remove_building = hanxing_mines_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = hanxing_mines_03 } remove_building = hanxing_mines_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = hanxing_mines_02 } remove_building = hanxing_mines_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = hanxing_mines_01 } remove_building = hanxing_mines_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = kaibao_mines_04 } remove_building = kaibao_mines_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = kaibao_mines_03 } remove_building = kaibao_mines_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = kaibao_mines_02 } remove_building = kaibao_mines_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = kaibao_mines_01 } remove_building = kaibao_mines_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_hetian_mines_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = hetian_mines_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hetian_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hetian_mines_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hetian_mines_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hetian_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hetian_mines_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hetian_mines_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hetian_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hetian_mines_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hetian_mines_04 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hetian_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hetian_mines_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_hetian_mines_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {

DI_tm_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = temple_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = church_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = stone_pagoda_01 } remove_building = stone_pagoda_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_thuriang_kilns_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = thuriang_kilns_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = thuriang_kilns_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = thuriang_kilns_01
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_temples_angkor_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = temples_angkor_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = temples_angkor_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = temples_angkor_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temples_angkor_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = temples_angkor_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = temples_angkor_02
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = temples_angkor_02 } remove_building = temples_angkor_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temples_angkor_01 } remove_building = temples_angkor_01 }
            }
        }
    }

            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }

                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = great_project_cathedral_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = great_project_cathedral_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = great_project_cathedral_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = great_project_cathedral_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = great_project_cathedral_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = great_project_cathedral_03
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                else_if = { limit = { has_building = great_project_cathedral_02 } remove_building = great_project_cathedral_02 }

                    set_holding_type = temple_citadel_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }

                }
                else_if = {

                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_citadel_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_citadel_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_remove_buildings_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building_or_higher = castle_02 } add_building = castle_01 }
                if = { limit = { has_building_or_higher = castle_03 } add_building = castle_01 }
                if = { limit = { has_building_or_higher = castle_04 } add_building = castle_01 }
                if = { limit = { has_building_or_higher = city_02 } add_building = city_01 }
                if = { limit = { has_building_or_higher = city_03 } add_building = city_01 }
